# CEO-to-Employee Pay Ratios, Societal-Level Income Inequality, and Citizens' Subjective Well-Being

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Kaifeng Jiang, Y. Jia, Anne S. Tsui, J. Yu  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** Journal of International Business Studies  
**DOI:** [10.1057/s41267-025-00616-3](https://doi.org/10.1057/s41267-025-00616-3)

**Keywords:** CEO pay ratio, income inequality, subjective well-being, compensation, societal outcomes

## Abstract

Examines how CEO-to-employee pay ratios interact with societal-level income inequality to affect citizens' subjective well-being, bridging compensation research with macro-level social outcomes.
